Airy the Stubborn

Biography

Airy the Stubborn guards Estera’s cave while the witch is away. Her exchanges with Kir and Kel include a rivalry over a necklace and directions to the Old Dragon. She also helps explain why the Magic Orb has lost its power after use, making her part of the search for a way to consult it again. [1, 2]
